records.title: Lost Marbles

prompts.A: Landscape browser-game arcade cover for a multiplayer marble racing game: glossy colorful marbles racing on a surreal floating racetrack above clouds at sunrise; polished stylized 3D key art; no text, logos, trademarks, watermark, or people.
prompts.B: Landscape browser-game arcade cover for a multiplayer marble racing game: glassy marbles banking around a neon night obstacle course with glowing rails, loops, ramps, sparks, and motion trails; polished stylized 3D arcade key art; no text, logos, trademarks, watermark, or people.

records.selection_reason: Variant B has clearer small-card silhouettes, stronger motion, and a more distinctive arcade-racing read.

records.title: Roadster Rush

prompts.A: Landscape browser-game arcade cover for a futuristic roadster endless runner: an original generic red flying roadster dodging geometric barriers and collecting energy bolts on an elevated highway through a luminous desert megacity; polished stylized 3D key art; no Tesla cues, brand marks, Subway Surfers characters or styling, text, logos, trademarks, or watermark.
prompts.B: Landscape browser-game arcade cover for a futuristic flying-car obstacle runner: an original generic silver hover roadster launching over a broken rain-slick neon skyway above a futuristic city; cinematic stylized 3D key art; no Tesla cues, brand marks, Subway Surfers characters or styling, text, logos, trademarks, or watermark.

records.selection_reason: Variant A reads most clearly as an obstacle runner at card size and avoids relying on the source game's third-party visual references.
